steps: Implement `prediction-data gold daily-run [--dt YYYY-MM-DD] [--dry-run]`
Default --dt to yesterday (UTC)
Execute in order: 1) load-dims, 2) process-trades, 3) compute-marks, 4) compute-wallet-metrics
Each step logs start/end and emits pipeline_runs metadata

description: Configurable ClickHouse loading from S3 Gold
steps: Implement `prediction-data gold ch-load --table TABLE [--lookback-days N] [--dry-run]`
Support all Gold tables: market_mark_daily, wallet_pnl_daily, wallet_mtm_daily, wallet_position_snapshot_daily, wallet_position_ledger
Default lookback: 90 days (configurable via --lookback-days)
Read S3 Gold Parquet partitions within lookback window, insert into ClickHouse
Handle TTL: ClickHouse TTL expressions handle old data expiry automatically
Add `prediction-data gold ch-load --all [--lookback-days N]` to load all tables

description: Rebuild Gold tables from Silver for a date range
steps: Implement `prediction-data gold rebuild --table TABLE --start-date YYYY-MM-DD --end-date YYYY-MM-DD`
For position accounting tables: must rebuild sequentially from earliest date (position state is cumulative)
For market_mark_daily: can rebuild individual days independently
For wallet metrics: depends on ledger, so rebuild ledger first if needed
Add --force flag to overwrite existing S3 Gold partitions
Log rebuild progress and summary
